name: Demon Dogs
label: Quest
description: Demon Dogs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you are going to remain here, I ask only that you earn your keep. We have many nuisances that could use some 'discipline.'
You can start with the Plaguehounds and their runts.
I cannot offer much in return, but you are guaranteed a warm meal and some conversation should you succeed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not pity the demon dogs, traveler. They are abominations!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. Come. Rest. Let us eat and talk of days long past!
